title: Qiskit Textbook — Learn Quantum Computation Using Qiskit
description: The official open-source interactive textbook covering quantum computing fundamentals, algorithms, and applications using Qiskit. Includes Jupyter notebooks for hands-on learning.

title: PennyLane Demos — Quantum Machine Learning Tutorials
description: Collection of hands-on demos covering variational quantum classifiers, quantum chemistry, quantum GANs, and more using PennyLane's autodiff-compatible quantum framework.

title: Cirq Tutorials — Google Quantum AI
description: Official tutorials for Google's Cirq framework covering circuit construction, noise simulation, and quantum algorithm implementation on Google's quantum processors.

title: IBM Quantum Lab — Run Circuits on Real Hardware
description: Cloud-based quantum computing environment providing free access to IBM's quantum processors. Run real circuits, explore noise characteristics, and benchmark algorithms.

title: Quantum Computing: An Applied Approach (Hidary)
description: Applied introduction to quantum computing covering gates, circuits, algorithms, error correction, and quantum machine learning with code examples in multiple frameworks.

title: Quantum Computation and Quantum Information (Nielsen & Chuang)
description: The definitive graduate-level textbook on quantum computation and information theory. Covers quantum mechanics, circuit model, algorithms, error correction, and entanglement in rigorous mathematical detail.

title: Amazon Braket Examples — Quantum Computing on AWS
description: Collection of Jupyter notebooks demonstrating quantum algorithms, hybrid jobs, and multi-framework (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane) execution on Amazon Braket's quantum service.

title: Qiskit Runtime Primitives — Efficient Quantum Workloads
description: Learn to use Qiskit Runtime's Sampler and Estimator primitives to run quantum workloads more efficiently on IBM Quantum hardware with built-in error mitigation.

title: Quantum Error Mitigation Techniques — A Practical Guide
description: Practical guide to error mitigation strategies for NISQ devices including zero-noise extrapolation, probabilistic error cancellation, and measurement error mitigation.

title: Simulating Molecules with VQE — Quantum Chemistry Tutorial
description: Step-by-step tutorial on using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver to compute ground state energies of small molecules (H₂, LiH) on quantum simulators and real hardware.
